question: In which of the following years was the Geological Survey of India established?
solution:
The correct answer is __1851__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Geological Survey of India is a Government of India Organization under the Ministry of Mines. 
 
• The headquarters of the Geological Survey of India is in Kolkata.
 
• The current Director General of the Geological Survey of India (GSI) is **Shri Asit Saha**, who took charge on July 27, 2024
 
• Regional offices of GSI in India are Lucknow, Jaipur, Nagpur, Hyderabad, Shillong and Kolkata.
